## Checklist

### Code Quality

- [ ] My code follows the project's style guidelines
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my code
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [ ] I have removed console.logs and debug statements
- [ ] I have updated type definitions (if applicable)

### Testing

- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works
- [ ] New and existing unit tests pass locally with my changes
- [ ] I have tested this on multiple browsers (if frontend change)

### Documentation

- [ ] I have updated the documentation accordingly
- [ ] I have updated the CHANGELOG (if applicable)
- [ ] I have added docstrings to new functions/classes
- [ ] API changes are reflected in OpenAPI/Swagger docs

### Security

- [ ] I have checked for security vulnerabilities
- [ ] I have not exposed any sensitive information (API keys, credentials)
- [ ] I have validated and sanitized user inputs (if applicable)
- [ ] I have followed secure coding practices

### Dependencies

- [ ] I have checked that new dependencies are necessary and well-maintained
- [ ] I have updated `requirements.txt` or `package.json` (if applicable)
- [ ] I have tested with the new dependencies
